text: {"label":"Pigeon Choice, Preference, and Reinforcement Schedules","definition":"Laboratory studies of pigeons' (and some rats') choice and preference under reinforcement schedules, including risky and suboptimal choice, discounting, sunk costs, token economies, timing, and resurgence.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Centers on choice and preference among reinforcement alternatives, unlike neighbours on key-peck response properties, visual discrimination and memory, or matching-to-sample and inference tasks."}
